profile.headline: Technical Team Lead (SWE) • CSM • DoD 8570 IAT II • Veteran
profile.summary: Technical Team Lead solving problems through programming and automation, and a former Firefighter/EMT, NASA intern, and Marine Corps veteran accustomed to working in challenging and deadline-oriented environments. Certified Scrum Master (CSM) and DoD 8570 IAT Level II Certified.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical Team Lead and Certified Scrum Master (CSM) delivering RHEL and Windows automation and cloud management solutions. Lead developer for both our cloud console and automated DISA STIG‑compliance system. Leverage and integrate Python, Ansible, PowerShell, AD, DNS, VMware/PowerCLI, and AWS APIs to support network operations; maintain Docker and Jenkins CI/CD; manage sprints and documentation via Jira and Confluence; and mentor developers. Provide real‑time support to system administrators and facilitate the integration of new technologies—such as AI—into existing processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Ansible · Scrum · Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · Information Security

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop and improve RHEL applications to automate network and operating system configuration and troubleshooting, for the U.S. Navy's Ship Self-Defense System (SSDS), using Python, Bash, Ansible, and CLI commands for Cisco, IBM, Palo Alto, and Perle devices, in compliance with the DISA STIGs.
positions.insights: Skills: Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · Network Programming · Cisco IOS · Python (Programming Language) · Automation

positions.title: Firefighter/EMT
positions.description: Worked in a challenging and time-critical environment, responding to over 500 fire and EMS calls a year. Used knowledge of C#, HTML/CSS, Java, JavaScript, and SQL database programming to create web and mobile applications for the department.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · SQL · C# · .NET Framework · HTML · JavaScript

positions.title: Development Intern
positions.description: Two-term intern with the Digital Transformation Team. Used knowledge of Bash, C, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Python, and SQL, as well as computer vision, machine learning, IoT devices, and Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) to improve legacy systems and develop new solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · Machine Learning · Bash · Python (Programming Language) · PHP

positions.title: Family Time, Travel, and Personal Projects
positions.description: Post-Military Sabbatical for Family Time, Travel, and Personal Projects.

positions.title: Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) Defense Officer
positions.description: Successfully performed missions in fast-paced and deadline-oriented settings, including three combat tours, rising from Private to Chief Warrant Officer. Leveraged programming and automation skills to manage several multi-million dollar accounts and train thousands of Marines and Sailors.

volunteerExperiences.description: Participated in Operation Hard Hustle in and around Beaumont, Texas, to provide disaster relief to flooding victims of Hurricane Harvey.
